scope: Matched same-GGUF 16K-depth c=1 decode device attribution on gfx1151

model.kv: BF16 in hipEngine; F16 in llama.cpp Vulkan

notes: The hipEngine trace segments the 127 synchronized one-row transitions after the first prefill-produced token.
The Vulkan log contains 32 depth-fill sections and 128 generation sections; the final 127 generation sections are selected to match hipEngine's transition count.

Vulkan operation logging groups concurrently scheduled nodes on one line. Its global FLASH_ATTN_EXT row also names the concurrent F16 output projection, so the reported global interval is an upper bound on pure Vulkan attention time.
Clean production walls come from the already-published matched depth packet. The profile-run walls are diagnostic and are not substituted for the clean topline.

flash_attention_group.qualification: The global and SWA rows include concurrently named F16 output projection work; they are scheduled-group intervals and upper bounds on pure FA time.

source_mechanism.gqa: The host folds N=1 into six query rows per global KV head, reducing 48 query-head owners to 8 KV-head owners.
source_mechanism.context_parallelism: Occupancy-derived split-K partitions the long KV axis and reduces only online-softmax output/max/denominator partials.
source_mechanism.arithmetic_contract: F16 K/V and default F16 cooperative accumulation; comparator only, not hipEngine's exact scalar FP32 association.

comparison.interpretation: Within profiler resolution, the complete device-active 16K gap is the generic global-attention route. hipEngine SWA is below Vulkan's complete SWA-plus-output scheduled group, but this is not a pure-FA comparison. Host dispatch and the rest of the overlapped device schedule are not the long-context limiter.

traffic_model.qualification: These are source-derived logical load-request ledgers, not DRAM counters. Cache broadcasts/reuse can reduce physical traffic. The contrast remains structural: hipEngine owns QK/PV per query head and materializes the full score/physical plane; Vulkan owns six queries per KV head and retains only split online-softmax partials.

decision.next_owner: An exact GQA6 context-parallel tiled global owner that removes the full score/physical plane and replaces the one-workgroup-per-query-head serial PV reducer with bounded split partials.
decision.first_gate: At 16K, reduce global attention from 86.240 ms/token to <=20 ms/token while preserving exact recurrent state; then require positive one-run 4K/16K/64K and mandatory 128K before promotion.
decision.stretch_gate: Vulkan-class <=5 ms/token scheduled global interval at 16K, subject to hipEngine's stricter arithmetic/correctness contract.
